Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.json

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.json
The JSON codec behind Eloquent's JSON casts and model serialization.

JsonCodec.standard() is a strict RFC 8259 parser and a compact writer with no third-party dependency. Decoded numbers are Long, BigInteger or BigDecimal — never Double — so a decode followed by an encode never rounds.

This package holds the codec contract, its exception and the standard implementation. It does not hold casts, model code or any database type.
